metadata.description: Everything I publish for Claude Code: kit (small skills), diagrams and triago.

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: Small personal skills: handoff (pass prompts and context between two computers through a private claude.ai artifact).

plugins.name: diagrams
plugins.description: Mermaid to Unicode text for chat, to sketch or clean pictures, and to narrated walkthroughs with voice, cues and a recall quiz.

plugins.name: triago
plugins.description: Post a list of findings to a browser card, decide each one with a keystroke, and get the decisions back as structured data. Runs on 127.0.0.1, makes no network calls.
